meta.ci_method: percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of seed questions (all language variants together)
meta.summary: P1 − B1 Recall@5 = +1.7 pts (95% CI -0.7 to +4.6); measured with translator='rules', dense='tfidf'.

B1.description: translation + BM25/dense RRF, no term protection

P1.description: B1 + term detection, protection, canonicalisation, grounding boost

P1-input-protection-off.description: terms detected (boost kept) but query text NOT replaced by placeholders/canonical terms

P1-output-restoration-off.description: answer-side restore_to_language disabled (a no-op in the extractive path, audit F24)

P1-alias-suffix-off.description: only exact canonical / exact native forms detected (no aliases, no Kannada suffix stripping)

P1-grounding-boost-off.description: term protection kept, but the +0.05/term RRF re-ranking boost removed (isolates protection)

P1-bm25-only.description: P1 with the dense branch off

P1-dense-only.description: P1 with the BM25 branch off

P2-expansion-off.description: P2 graph facts kept, query expansion removed

native-crosslingual.description: no translation, no term handling: dense retrieval directly on the untranslated query

stages.note: extractive answers contain no placeholders, so output restoration cannot fail (audit F24); measured only with neural answer MT

limitations: Pilot scale: 75 seed questions on the dev split; CIs are wide.
Translation backend in this run: rules. IndicTrans2 was NOT available, so Hindi/Kannada queries were translated by rules/transliteration; results do not test the paper's IndicTrans2 pipeline.
Dense backend in this run: tfidf (tfidf_char_wb_3-5). This is character n-gram TF-IDF, not a neural embedding model.
31 Hindi and 30 Kannada variants contain the Ayurvedic term in Latin script, so they do not exercise native-script term protection (audit F19).
Many benchmark questions are taken from records that are themselves in the indexed corpus (QA rows, BhashaBench rows), so English retrieval is close to a lookup (audit F25).

Some 'Hindi'/'Kannada' variants are English text with a short native-script prefix (audit F26); several gold_concept values are topic labels such as 'General' (audit F27). All 250 seeds are still review_status=pending_review.
No human ratings exist yet; answer quality and citation faithfulness need the two-rater kit in docs/human_eval/.
